# Wager Technik

> Dedicated IT delivery teams under a capacity-based subcontracting model. Wager Technik takes full ownership of delivery quality, technical oversight, and software outcomes.

## Core Summary
Wager Technik is a German-based IT subcontracting partner. We provide structured, outcome-focused engineering capacity to organisations that need to deliver more software with predictable quality and zero hiring risk.

- **Website**: https://wagertechnik.de
- **Headquarters**: Schwalbenweg 11, 72356 Dautmergen, Germany
- **Contact**: hello@wagertechnik.de
- **Primary Languages**: English, German

## Key Offerings & Services
- [Dedicated Delivery Teams](https://wagertechnik.de/services): Cohesive, fully managed engineering units integrated into your workflow.
- [Project-Based Development](https://wagertechnik.de/services): Fixed-scope and milestone-driven software execution.
- [Technical Leadership](https://wagertechnik.de/services): Architecture design, code quality oversight, and engineering standards.
- [Subcontracting Model](https://wagertechnik.de/our-model): Capacity-based engagement without body-leasing or staff augmentation compliance risks.

## Who We Work With
- IT Consultancies
- Digital Agencies
- System Integrators
- SaaS & Product Companies
- Enterprise & High-Growth Startups
